text: I keep noticing that my best ideas come when I'm walking rather than when I sit down to think.
I realised that tracking something is only useful if it helps me understand my behaviour, not just collect more data.
There is a difference between wanting to optimise life and forgetting to actually live it.
Maybe repeated thoughts are not random. Maybe they are patterns waiting to be noticed.
Learning Git made more sense when I stopped memorising commands and started asking why each tool exists.
